text:
Type: white gooseneck LED wall lamp
Use: reading light beside a bed, a sofa or a desk; bedroom, living room, home office
Style: minimalist, modern, Scandinavian
Materials: white plastic wall disc with a switch, flexible white gooseneck arm, small cylindrical head
Colors: white, grey switch
Shape: round flat wall plate with a slender arched flexible arm ending in a small cup head, light and discreet, compact
Feel: clean, simple, practical, soft
Goes with: white walls, light wood headboards, pale textiles; Scandinavian or minimalist bedrooms

product.name: BLVIK
product.description: Batteries are sold separately, 3 pcs HR6,AA required. View more product information Easy to install without drilling. You can mount the lamp to the wall using the suction cup, self-adhesive backing or screws.
